Alkaloids like caffeine and theobromine may reduce the ability of viruses to attach to host cells. Flavonoids, including quercetin and catechins, possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects that support the immune system. Together, these components contribute to the plant's potential role in preventing and mitigating viral infections.
benefits.study: According to "Alternative therapies in health and medicine", Camellia sinensis has been proven to be effective in vivo against viral infections, including COVID-19.

intro: Camellia sinensis, commonly known as the tea plant, offers a wide range of health benefits due to its rich content of antioxidants, polyphenols, and other bioactive compounds. Regular consumption of tea made from this plant can improve heart health by reducing cholesterol levels and lowering the risk of cardiovascular diseases. It also supports mental alertness and cognitive function, thanks to its caffeine and L-theanine content, which can enhance focus and reduce stress. Additionally, Camellia sinensis may aid in weight management, boost the immune system, and even reduce the risk of certain cancers, making it a valuable addition to a healthy lifestyle.
